name: Migrations
description: Standard e configurazioni per le migrazioni del database

table.description: Nome della tabella su cui opera la migrazione

rules.name: migration-file-naming
rules.description: I file di migrazione devono seguire il formato YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_descriptive_name.php

rules.name: migration-class-naming
rules.description: Le classi di migrazione devono essere in PascalCase

create_table.content:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Modules\Xot\Database\Migrations\XotBaseMigration;

return new class extends XotBaseMigration
{
    protected string $table = '{{table_name}}';
    
    protected $connection = null;
    
    public function up(): void
    {
        if (Schema::hasTable($this->table)) {
            return;
        }
        
        Schema::create($this->table, function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            // Aggiungi qui le tue colonne
            $table->timestamps();
            $table->softDeletes();
        });
    }
    
    public function down(): void
    {
        Schema::dropIfExists($this->table);
    }
};
